_comment: Strassen-Winograd recursion depth per n^3 family (0 = dense): family = transport of the young legs + newborn + covariance, hub = young-source D21 contraction, form / inner = shared-basis formings / contractions, sym = covariance sandwich, join = the joiner's n x n x r products. Deeper = fewer FLOPs, more flopscope ops (residual time, capped at 400 ms per MLP on the grader). Batches are chunked so no array exceeds the grader's 100 MiB cap. fuse = form the deepest level's seven products one at a time (7x smaller deepest stacks, half the chunks). first_levels applies to the first predict() of a process, which also pays buffer allocation. compact = how many top levels use the coefficient-matmul combinations (6 ops/level, more FLOPs) instead of grouped block additions (15 ops/level). Calibration on this repo's container: the team's v5b submission (graded fine) runs at ~1.2 s local residual; this setting runs at 0.94-1.03 s (C/B 0.2665 with the v5b operator).
